source: Blaze Black 2 Redux 1.4.1: Move Changes.txt (hacks/blaze-black-2-redux/.src, the Redux doc; the same lines are in data.json MV.h); Psyshield Bash checked against Move Changes.txt and the repo's move table (hzla/bb2redux1-4.json lists it as the Smelling Salts replacement). notes: Rock Smash: secondary Defense -1 is 100 % (doc: "50% Def -1 -> 100% Def -1"), was 50 % (Move Changes.txt, Rock Smash)
String Shot: Speed -2 instead of -1 (doc: "Speed -1 -> Speed -2", Move Changes.txt, String Shot)

Psyshield Bash (replaces Smelling Salts): raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by one stage, guaranteed (doc: "Rasies the user's Defense and Special Defense by one stage.", Move Changes.txt, Psyshield Bash)

Checked, no override: Headlong Rush (table already drops Def and SpD -1, doc "like Close Combat"); Howl (table is user-only Attack +1, doc "Raises only Users Attack"); Acid Armor / Barrier / Swords Dance / Charm / Swagger / Thunder Wave / Growth (sun 2) match the doc or only change PP / power / accuracy; Lunge, Fire Lash, Breaking Swipe, Mystical Fire, Moonblast, Power-Up Punch, Nuzzle, Play Rough, Accelerock, Infestation, Smart Strike (replacements) keep their table effects; Crabhammer, Power Gem, Strength, Raging Fury, Scald, Poison Fang, Leaf Tornado, Octazooka: the new or changed effects are chances (never applied) or accuracy / PP only; Raging Fury's self-confusion is a volatile on the user (not modelled)
